# API reference

All endpoints are under `/api/v1` unless noted. Every one requires
authentication: a session bearer token from `/auth/login`, or an
`X-API-Key` header for a customer's own automation.

Cross-tenant reads return **404**, not 403, so an identifier cannot be
confirmed by probing.

An interactive schema is served at `/docs` outside production.

## Roles

| Role | Can |
|---|---|
| `viewer` | Read everything in the org |
| `approver` | Also decide approvals and review content |
| `editor` | Also create sites, edit content and set schedules |
| `admin` | Also connect and disconnect integrations |
| `owner` | Everything |

## Error shape

Domain errors carry a machine-readable code so a client can branch on
it rather than parse prose.

```json
{ "code": "budget_exceeded", "message": "...", "context": {} }
```

| Code | Status | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `approval_required` | 202 | The action is legitimate but policy says a human signs off first. |
| `budget_exceeded` | 402 | A run or an org hit its spend ceiling. Never silently ignored. |
| `conflict` | 409 |  |
| `connector_error` | 502 | An outbound integration failed. Usually retryable by another route. |
| `credential_missing` | 424 | A connector is not configured. Not retryable without human action. |
| `not_found` | 404 |  |
| `permission_denied` | 403 |  |
| `provider_error` | 502 |  |
| `rate_limited` | 429 |  |
| `safety_refusal` | 403 | The action would damage the client. Refused, never escalated. |
| `validation_failed` | 422 |  |
